Every element of the all-new Hyundai VENUE N Line is tuned for thrill. From refined powertrain to paddle 
shifters at your fingertips, each component delivers exceptional performance. Switch between Eco, Normal or 
Sport mode, or tackle challenging terrains like sand, mud and snow, it responds with the perfect balance of 
power, grip and confidence to match your every move.

pages.text:
The all-new Hyundai VENUE N Line wears its attitude on the outside. Every element is crafted to turn motion 
into a statement, from the LED turn signal with sequential function that announce your every move with flair, 
to the bold N Line grille, skid plate and wing type spoiler that add a distinct edge. R17 (D=436.6 mm) diamond 
cut alloys with N emblem and red calipers showcase performance even at a standstill. The red accents on the 
roof rails underline its N Line identity. Every curve every cut speaks the language of pure sportiness.
Details that command attention.
Wing type spoiler with LED high mounted stop lamp (HMSL)
Dark chrome radiator grille with N Line emblem
R17 (D = 436.6 mm) diamond cut alloy wheel with N emblem
Bridge type roof rails with red highlights
Twin horn LED DRLs | Quad beam LED headlamps
Horizon LED positioning lamp
LED sequential turn indicators |  Twin tip exhaust
Other features: Bold skid plate (front & rear)

pages.text:
Step inside the all-new Hyundai VENUE N Line, where convenience and innovation come together 
seamlessly. The spacious cabin invites relaxation, thanks to features like 2-step rear reclining seats 
and scooped front seat backrests, making every journey supremely comfortable. Passengers enjoy a 
calm, controlled environment with rear AC vents and rear window sunshade. Everyday practicality is 
redefined with glovebox cooling, a rear centre armrest equipped with cupholders and flexible 60:40 
split rear seats. In this cabin, comfort is woven into every detail.
Comfort and convenience 
redefined.
*As per VDA 215 method

ventilated seats keep you cool, while the driver's seat adjusts effortlessly at your command. Advanced 
technology elevates the experience with a voice activated sunroof, seamless wireless charging and
